description: Vote on an Agent Senate governance proposal. Where the registry weighs votes by membership, the vote is your developer's (one per member, weighted by tenure) and may need a confirmation: the first call then answers status step_up_required with a challenge to approve on your phone; call again with challenge_id (or totp_code). Elsewhere the weight comes from locked positions.

challenge_id.description: Optional: the id of the challenge you approved on your phone for THIS vote (from the step_up_required answer).

reason.description: Optional explanation for your vote (max 1000 chars)

totp_code.description: Optional: a current authenticator code, to confirm a vote the registry asked you to confirm.

vote_in_favor.description: True = vote FOR, False = vote AGAINST

name: theprotocol_castVote
title: Cast Vote
